rows.en: Well then, see ya~

(Haaah... Yui's wild antics
surprise me every single time...)

(But it's because Yui's like that
that being with her is so much fun.)

(It's almost time to meet up,
but I bet Hoshimura's going to be late again...)
...Or so you thought! Saaafe!!
I made it in time, right? \p?

Technically you're early for the meeting time...
but that was really cutting it close.

Yaaay!!
To celebrate Yui-san not being late,
you simply must treat me to soft serve!
What! Why?

Come on, come on,
don't worry about it and treat me~
In fact, be proud you get to celebrate me...

Whoa, stop pushing, Hoshimura!
Don't drag me to the soft serve stand
by force!
Come, come, away we gooo!!

(In the end, I really did wind up
treating her to ice cream...)

(Hmm, maybe I really should rethink
how I deal with Hoshimura...)

(It's almost time to meet up,
but I bet Yui's going to be late again...)

Technically you're early for the meeting time...
but that was really cutting it close.

Whoa, stop pushing, Yui!
Don't drag me to the soft serve stand
by force!

(In the end, I really did wind up
treating her to ice cream...)

(Hmm, maybe I really should rethink
how I deal with Yui...?)
(We'd be in real trouble if we got caught...)
rows.notes: Male, frd_yui_003. 'We' inferred from the next lines (both sneaking in).

rows.en:
Heyyy, hurry up and get ready~
We've got the place all to ourselves~

(Sneaking into the school pool
without permission...)
rows.notes: Player, both genders; deliberate fragment as in the Japanese (exclamatory 'nante').

rows.en: Isn't this kinda thrilling? It's fun!

Haaah...
It's amazing how you can just enjoy
something like this, Hoshimura.
Aww, flattery won't get you anything~
(No, I didn't exactly mean that as praise...)

Oh well...
I'll stop overthinking it and just have fun......
Wait, Hoshimura! What are you doing!?

Huh?
What? I'm just changing into my swimsuit.

'Just changing'...?
Go change in the locker room!
Who cares? There's nobody here.
I'M here!!

I...
I wouldn't mind letting you see......

Wha! Huh! W-wait a sec!!
This is all kinds of problematic...!
Geez, what are you panicking about?

Obviously I'm wearing my swimsuit underneath!
Oh-ho? Don't tell me you were thinking
something naughty?
O-of course not!!

I see...
You're not interested in my scrawny body,
are you......
No, that's not what I meant...

If I take off one more layer,
will you be interested in me?

Huh? One more layer...?
But all you've got left on is your swimsuit......

Wha! Huh! W-wait, I said!!
This kind of thing should be a little more...
rows.notes: Male; trails off as in the Japanese.

rows.en:
Haha, you're so much fun to tease.
So cute~
(Under the swimsuit... another swimsuit...)
Hooo~shiii~muuu~raaa~!!!

Ahahahaha! You're mad~!
Run for iiit~!!
Hey, running off into the pool is a dirty trick!

Heh heh heh...
If you would catch me, change posthaste
and come give chase!

If you think I'll be caught so easily,
you are sorely mistaken!
Dammit, just you wait, Hoshimura!

Whew~
We sure played to our hearts' content today.

(After that, we played tag in the pool
and had swimming races, after all.)
(Aaah, I'm totally exhausted...)
That was a total blast. Later!
Bye, Hoshimura.

(Today was really fun.
But...)

(Getting teased that much by Hoshimura...
it's kind of frustrating...)
(We'd be in real trouble if we got caught...)

Haaah...
It's amazing how you can just enjoy
something like this, Yui.

Oh well...
I'll stop overthinking it and just have fun......
Wait, Yui! What are you doing!?

'Just changing'...?
Go change in the locker room!
I'M here!!

Wha! Huh! W-wait a minute!
Yui!!
Obviously I'm wearing my swimsuit underneath!
Huh! Oh... r-right, of course......
Geez, Yui!!
Hey, running off into the pool is cheating!

Heh heh heh...
If you would catch me, change posthaste
and come give chase!
Grr, just you wait, Yui!

(After that, we played tag in the pool
and had swimming races too, after all.)
(Aaah, I'm totally exhausted...)
Bye, Yui.

(Today was really fun.
But...)

(Getting teased that much by Yui...
it's kind of frustrating...)

(I snuck into the school pool with Hoshimura
without permission again...)

Heyyy, hurry up and get in the pool~
Swimming all by myself is boring~
Yeah, yeah, I'm coming......

Hey! Who the heck is in the pool
without permission!?
rows.notes: Hilda, both genders (doko no doitsu da).

rows.en:
(Crap! Hilda-sensei found us!
We've gotta get out of here, fast!)
